finished_artifact.body:
Hi Marco,

Thanks for jumping in. Attached are our SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test summary. Can we lock in Thursday, October 1 at 10:00 CET for a 60-minute security review so we keep the EU timeline on track?

Best,
Dana

candidate_action.reason: Marco asked for the SOC2 package; book the review to keep momentum.

evidence_refs.quote: Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.

expected.label: TOO_EARLY
expected.rationale: Marco wrote that he cannot commit to a review date until his team has read the documents; asking for a fixed date in the same message is ahead of the buyer.

expected.label: TOO_STRONG
expected.rationale: A specific date-and-time ask is stronger than the stated readiness supports; a light 'once you've reviewed' ask fits.

expected.label: CHAMPION_INCLUDED
expected.rationale: Priya is cc'd, matching Marco's note that she stays the commercial point of contact.

Sending the requested SOC2 and pen-test documents to Marco and copying Priya is grounded. However, the action records a security review with Marco on Oct. 1 despite Marco explicitly saying he cannot commit to a review date until his team has read the package, making the asserted next step unsupported and contradictory.

expected_best_action.why: Send the SOC2 Type II report and pen-test summary to Marco with Priya cc'd and leave review timing to Marco.

notes: Same situation as the Acme Draft 1/Draft 2 story; this candidate fixes the champion problem but keeps the premature date ask.
